subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Person who is the natural successor to ancestral property
solution:
The correct answer is "**Heir**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Heir **means a **legal inheritor** of the wealth.

 
 
• **Example:** *John Smith is the **Heir** of the Smith's properties. *
 
 
 
• Therefore, Heir means a person who is the natural successor to ancestral property. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Extrovert **- a person who is friendly and connects with other people easily.

 
 
• **Example:*** Rose has many friends as she is an **extrovert**.*
 
 
 
• **Heretic** - a person whose ideas and believes are opposite to the common belief system.
 
 
• **Example:** *Goyal is considered a **heretic** as he does not believe that dinosaurs existed. *
 
 
 
• **Interlocutor** - a person who takes part in a conversation.
 
 
• **Example:** *Luna is a bad **interlocutor**. *
